section: Engine: src/rules_core/sheet_rule.rs link_path_a_picks (the 'if found.is_empty()' fallback added by F4pre, commit 4248733c1d)
problem: The fallback links a pick to the wrong choice, which puts a domain on the sheet that the player never chose. For any Path-A pick 'choice:<pool> -> <ns>:<member>', it looks up a rule named '<member>' in every kind (find_in_every_kind) and links the pick to any held Domains/Rules chooser that offers that rule. It never checks that the pick's pool or namespace belongs to that chooser, and it never reads the chooser's count. So the Human ability-bonus pick 'choice:human_ability_bonus -> ability:strength' (GE-06 fixture line 28; the desktop records the same shape at pf1_adapter.rs:579-580) becomes core_rulebook:domain:strength under any held domain count. f4pre-receipt.md §6 claims 'No default was invented'. No receipt cites these lines.
evidence: Command: class_census --sheet-dump <build> --with-sheet-rules, run on a read-only git-archive build of tranche/16 @070c253e93 and on this branch; deltas sorted by f1c_render_classify.py, f1c_render_pairs.py and f1c_render_attribute.py. Results: cleric 5 gains LINE rows for core_rulebook:domain:strength 'Strength', core_domain_strength_domain 'Strength' and domain_power_strength_surge 'Strength Surge', while its seeded domain:good stays unheld. shaman 5 gains domain:strength and core_domain_strength_domain. paladin 5 gains the same two lines even though its own 'Paladin (domains)' line prints +0. cleric 1 is the same as cleric 5. In the scan of all 63 non-prestige census classes at min(5, max level), 3 of 63 carry the fabricated domain (cleric, paladin, shaman). The desktop sheet calls the same with_linked_picks (class_shared_core.rs:50, character_hub.rs:782/5088), so a desktop Human cleric, paladin or shaman who puts the +2 on Str prints this domain.
fix: Keep ONE rule. The bare-<member> candidate should answer only when the pick's namespace names the option's kind (domain:air -> kind domain). The <pool>_<member> candidate stays as it is, so the shaman spirit:life -> shaman_spirit_life link still works. A chooser whose count evaluates to 0 offers nothing. Write the failing tests first: a Human cleric 5 with ability:strength holds no domain:strength, and paladin 5 holds no domain. Then scan every held rule reached through a linked pick over the 63-class population, with its denominator, and require 0 links from a choice whose pool is not the chooser's.
